basic_info.description: Stylish and thoughtfully reimagined in 2016 with top Bay Area engineer and general contractor, this 3-bedroom, 2-bath residence sits at the edge of Crocker-Amazon Park in the dynamic Excelsior District. Tucked away on a quiet end street, the home offers rare privacy and direct access to green space perfect for nature lovers and city dwellers alike. The backyard is a sun filled garden retreat, complete with a versatile shed ideal for a home office or creative studio. Spanning two levels, including a beautifully finished lower level, the home blends character with comfort. Perfectly positioned near local markets and a lively mix of neighborhood restaurants, this home offers more than just convenience it's a lifestyle. Spend your weekends catching live music at the Jerry Garcia Amphitheater or playing a round at nearby Gleneagles Golf Course. Everything you need and love is just minutes from your door.  Just blocks from sprawling McLaren Park and just minutes to both Hwy 280, 101 and public transportation, this is your opportunity to live connected yet tucked away in one of San Francisco's most vibrant corners.
